description: Import and Export Control Department - Import and Export (Control) Regulations No. 06 of 2020
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969. It contains legal/regulatory content including the amendment of time periods for submitting Goods Received Notes to Sri Lanka Customs and establishes new regulations (Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 06 of 2020). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or organizational gazette.
